test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect form:

The instructor said, “Maintain silence in the classroom.”

options.text: The instructor told silence in the classroom.
The instructor ordered to maintain silence.
The instructor instructed them to maintain silence in the classroom.
The instructor said silence is needed in the classroom.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The instructor instructed them to maintain silence in the classroom.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
